name: Classroom Simulator
description: RPG classroom simulator. Judge classmates and answer the teacher. Static mode uses the author’s Quiz V2 questionnaires; dynamic mode adds optional local AI.

descriptions.en: RPG classroom simulator. Judge classmates and answer the teacher. Static mode uses the author’s Quiz V2 questionnaires; dynamic mode adds optional local AI.
descriptions.es: Simulador de aula RPG. Juzga a tus compañeros y responde al profesor. Modo estático: cuestionarios Quiz V2 del autor; modo dinámico: IA local opcional.
